product_details.title: clodcapture
product_details.summary: Save, export, and continue AI chat sessions across conversations with auto-capture and version history.
product_details.description:
clodcapture automatically captures your AI chat sessions as you browse, storing them locally with unlimited storage. Features include:

Auto-capture: Sessions are saved automatically as you navigate between chats. No manual steps required.

Floating spider button: A draggable button on the chat page opens your recent chats; one click continues any of them in a new chat. Toggle with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+K.

Timeline spine: Pick exactly which messages to carry over with a vertical scrubber - quick ranges (last 10, since the last break), zoom, live token estimate, and the opening messages always kept for context.

Portable chat keys: Each chat gets a compact summary card with tags. Combine up to five chats into one new session, edit tags, group related chats into projects, and export/import keys between browsers.

Session links: Chats you continue are linked to the chat they came from.

One-click export: Download any captured session as JSON, or bulk-export everything as a zip.

GitHub backup: Optionally push captured sessions to your own GitHub repository.

Context usage gauge: See how much of the context window the current conversation uses.

Optional API key: Connect your own API key for AI-written session digests, summary keys and exact token counts.

Captured data is stored in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you turn on GitHub backup or add an API key. No accounts, no tracking.

cws_privacy.single_purpose: Captures and exports AI chat sessions for local backup and cross-session continuity.

permission_justifications.storage: Stores captured session metadata and user preferences (API key, GitHub config) locally.
permission_justifications.unlimitedStorage: Sessions can be large (500KB+ each). Unlimited storage ensures no data loss as the capture library grows.
permission_justifications.tabs: Detects which chat is active to enable auto-capture on navigation and display current session info in the popup.
permission_justifications.alarms: Runs a background refresh every 30 minutes to keep captured sessions up to date.
permission_justifications.cookies: Authenticates API requests to the chat platform using existing session cookies. No cookies are read, stored, or transmitted externally.
permission_justifications.downloads: Exports captured sessions as JSON files to the user's Downloads folder.
permission_justifications.clipboardWrite: Copies session data to clipboard when direct composer loading is unavailable.
permission_justifications.clipboardRead: Reads clipboard only during the paste-into-composer flow to verify content was loaded.
permission_justifications.scripting: Loads the content script into the active tab to enable composer loading and auto-capture on single-page navigation.
permission_justifications.host_permissions_claude_ai: The extension operates on this specific AI chat platform. Required to read conversation data via the platform's API and to load content into the chat composer.
permission_justifications.host_permissions_api_anthropic: Optional. Used only when the user configures an API key to generate session digests and exact token counts.
permission_justifications.host_permissions_api_github: Optional. Used only when the user configures GitHub backup to push captured sessions to their repository.

cws_privacy._website_content_note: The extension reads chat conversation content from the active tab to capture and store it locally. It leaves the user's machine only when the user turns on GitHub backup (sent to their own repository) or saves an API key (chat text is sent to api.anthropic.com to build digests, summary keys and token counts).

cws_test_instructions.additional_instructions:
1. Install the extension.
2. Open a chat on the supported platform - it is captured automatically.
3. Open the extension popup - the current chat title appears and the captured chats list fills in.
4. Click 'Copy JSON' to copy the session, 'Save File' to download it, 'Export All' to download every chat as a zip.
5. Click the arrow on any captured chat to continue it in a new chat.
6. On the chat page, click the floating spider (or press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+K) to open the panel; 'Go' opens the timeline spine (Full mode) or continues from the chat's key (Key mode).
7. Long-press two chats in the panel and click 'Go with 2 keys' to combine them.
8. Open Settings (gear icon) to configure the optional API key, GitHub backup, and key export/import.
